messages.subject: Project Atlas - ready for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles,

Everything is in order for completion tomorrow. Your board minutes approving the acquisition are signed, the SPA and disclosure letter are agreed and engrossed, the escrow letter with Wycombe Trust is signed, and the EMI options have been exercised conditionally on completion so you will acquire 100%. We will hold documents to order and release on confirmation of funds. I will call you once completion has taken place.

Congratulations in advance.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
